name: Skill Manager
description: Create custom skills, specific to how your team works.
capabilities: Install skills from git and marketplaces
examples: Clone this skill repo and install it for my engineering agents
Install this skill from the marketplace, but check it for anything malicious first
Create a skill that teaches my sales agent our proposal format
Turn this runbook into a reusable skill for the on-call agent
Port this Claude skill from GitHub so it works on Hivy
long_description: Skill Manager lets your default Hivy agent author skills for your organization. Describe a workflow, or share a git repository or marketplace listing with an existing skill, and the agent installs it into its sandbox, runs a security review (prompt injection, malicious scripts, data exfiltration, suspicious dependencies), studies it, adapts anything that would not work on the Hivy platform (browser automation, persistence, secrets, ports), dry-runs the scripts, and shows you the final skill — including every security finding — for approval before publishing. Skills are grouped into org plugins you name — Sales, Engineering, Support — and those plugins attach to any agent, so each team's agents carry exactly the skills they need.
